BrochureContent.Content:
Introducing No.3A Shannon Cove to the market, a luxurious 2 bed apartment nestled in a prestigious gated community overlooking the majestic River Shannon and its enchanting harbour. 

This exquisite 2-bedroom apartment offers a lifestyle of unparalleled beauty, comfort, and convenience. With modern fixtures, breathtaking views from a spaious balconey, this is where luxury meets tranquillity.

Situated in a gated community, this apartment offers the perfect blend of privacy and community living. Immerse yourself in the serene surroundings while still being close to all amenities and conveniences. 

Ideally placed offering panoramic views of the River Shannon and private harbour from your own private balcony. Whether it's sunrise or sunset, every moment will be a visual masterpiece.

No.3 Shannon Cove spans to approximately 94 sq.mt including balaconey area. This spacious apartment provides ample room relaxation and entertainment. Every corner is thoughtfully designed to maximize comfort and functionality. The apartment is perfectly maintained by its current owners boasting modern fixtures and fittings ensuring a seamless blend of style and functionally.

The layout of the apartment allows for a smooth flow from room to room, accommodation comprises of a well appointed kitchen completed with ample countertops, generous storage space and comfortable dinging area. The sitting room is a welcoming room flooded with natural light and show cases the picturesque view from the adjoining balcony. This apartment features two generously sized bedrooms. The master bedroom boasts an ensuite and allows access to the baloney area making it the prefect spot to watch the sun set. A family size bathroom is located just across the hall. 

The option to purchase a marina berth is available, please note it is not included in the listing price.
